ctx.x: Well, it's hard to say, because we had -- when we made that major change like that, most of the men coming into the band, as I say, was from Horace Henderson's band. And they had a different style than we had. So we adapted our style.
Well, did Earl hear these guys? Did Horace play the Grand Terrace?
